environment: isolated experiments/.venv_multisolver; initial target Python3.12.14, numpy2.5.4, warp-lang1.18.0, mujoco3.15.0, mujoco-warp3.15.0, locally built pinned Newton1.7.0; actual resolved environment recorded
device_plan: CPU first; Kamino CUDA graph conditionals disabled for CPU. Record real limitations or any explicit backend/environment revision; failed runs do not count as measured pairs.

common.timing: Newton solver.step plus device synchronization; state export and serialization excluded. Report initialization and cold compilation separately where observable, median after first five steps, never cross-solver performance ranking.
common.assets: programmatic primitives; freeze model description and runner SHA256; no external asset download

cases.scene: five-box stack over global plane; 0.2m cubes, deterministic small tilt and gaps
cases.primary: ground penetration mm and final stack height m
secondary: actual solver iteration counters if available
cases.hypothesis: Tight coupled contact response can be under-solved at one iteration; an insignificant difference is also an admissible result.

cases.scene: radius0.1m sphere, density-derived mass1kg, drop from centerZ0.35m onto plane
cases.parameter_group: shape_material_ke / shape_material_kd on both shapes, fixed legacy numerical damping ratio
cases.hypothesis: Stronger numerical contact response changes sag/settling, with refsafe imposing a positive-solref time-constant floor. The ke/kd co-intervention is not isolated ke or a universal physical critical-damping rule.

cases.backend: PADMM with CPU-compatible unrolled iteration scheduling
cases.primary: PADMM residuals and converged fraction alongside physical ground penetration/stack height
cases.hypothesis: A small iteration budget may leave larger constraint residuals; interpretation stays within the same residual definitions and scene.

cases.scene: radius0.1m sphere intentionally starts at centerZ0.085m, 15mm initial plane overlap
cases.primary: residual overlap mm and recovery/overshoot trajectory
cases.hypothesis: Contact position-error correction differs from iteration convergence; alpha is for bilateral joints, beta for joint limits, gamma for contacts, delta is penetration margin.

acceptance: at least two successful reproducible A/B pairs per new solver, with identical initial state/common inputs within each pair
full requested and resolved config, actual diff and evidence that the treatment reaches its backend setting
finite states and valid nonempty physical sampling; failures/unsupported environments kept separate
runner, protocol, model/asset, dependency and raw hashes; explicit run IDs, units, sample times and timing scope
metrics independently recomputed from raw arrays and matching displayed curves/replay; source mechanism and limits cited
preserve all original VBD NPZ and frozen runner hashes; do not borrow VBD measurements for another solver
